models.name: MSST custom command
models.availability: Requires your local MSST checkout and model files
models.notes: Best for newer Roformer/SCNet models that the guide says work better in MSST than UVR.

recommendations.name: MVSep Ensemble 11.93
recommendations.why: The supplied guide lists it as a top vocal/instrumental ensemble, with vocal SDR 11.93 and instrumental SDR 18.24.
recommendations.caveat: This is an MVSep service ensemble, not the easiest single local download.

recommendations.name: Unwa BS-Roformer Resurrection instrumental
recommendations.why: The guide calls it public, UVR-compatible, fast, about 204 MB, and strong for instrumental extraction.
recommendations.caveat: It is an instrumental-focused model, so pair it with a strong vocal model if you want a true ensemble.

recommendations.name: Demucs htdemucs_ft
recommendations.why: Best practical local smoke test because the Demucs CLI can fetch it automatically and the app can run it with one command.
recommendations.caveat: It is not the bleeding-edge ensemble from the guide, but it is the easiest free local test path.
